32900.meaning2: difficult to bring or lead towards (?)

32901.meaning1: source of suffering; cause of discomfort
32901.commentary: (MNa) imassā'ti paccuppannānaṃ pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ mūlabhūtassa. dukkhanidānassā'ti taṇhāya. sā hi pañcakkhandhadukkhassa nidānaṃ.

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, imassa kho me dukkhanidānassa saṅkhāraṃ padahato saṅkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti, imassa pana me dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekkhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hotī'ti.

32903.meaningLit: discourse on the uncomfortable being conducive to complete quenching

32904.meaning1: end of suffering; cessation of distress
32904.commentary: (ANa) tassā'y'eva taṇhāya, dvinnam'pi vā tesaṃ saccānaṃ accantakkhayo asamuppatti dukkhanirodho nāma

examples.text: dukkhaṃ, bhikkhave, veditabbaṃ, dukkhassa nidānasambhavo veditabbo, dukkhassa vemattatā veditabbā, dukkhassa vipāko veditabbo, dukkhanirodho veditabbo, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā veditabbā.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, avijjā? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ.

32905.meaning1: path of practice leading to the cessation of suffering

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, avijjā? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ.
ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ

32906.meaning1: noble truth of the path of practice leading to the ending of suffering
32906.meaning2: noble truth of the way leading to the cessation of dukkha

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ? ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccan'ti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.

32907.meaning1: path of practice leading to the cessation of suffering
32907.meaning2: path of practice leading to the cessation of suffering

32908.meaning1: leading to the cessation of suffering
32908.meaning2: (the practice) leading to the extinction of suffering
32908.commentary: (SNa) dukkhanirodhagāminī samanupassanā'ti ettha saha vipassanāya catumaggañāṇaṃ samanupassanā'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, avijjā? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti. iti h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati dukkhanirodhagāminī samanupassanā'ti. ayam'ev'ettha attho'ti.

32909.meaning1: noble truth of the ending of suffering
32909.meaning2: noble truth of the cessation of dukkha

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ? yo tassā'y'eva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo.
sukh'āvaho dukkhanudo, vedehassa yasassino, matiṃ te paṭihaññāmi, usuṃ palasatena vā.

32911.meaning1: gone to the end of suffering

examples.text: mālaṃ na dhāre na ca gandham'ācare, mañce chamāyaṃ va sayetha santhate, etañ'hi aṭṭh'aṅgika-māh'uposathaṃ, buddhena dukkh'antagunā pakāsitaṃ.
dukkhan'ti khandhe paṭipassa yoniso, yato ca dukkhaṃ samudeti taṃ jaha, idh'eva dukkhassa karohi antaṃ, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
so idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodho'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ

32913.meaning1: this is unpleasant; this is painful

examples.text: kiñ'ca vijānāti? sukhan'ti'pi vijānāti, dukkhan'ti'pi vijānāti, adukkham'asukhan'ti'pi vijānāti. vijānāti vijānātī'ti kho, āvuso, tasmā viññāṇan'ti vuccatī'ti.
dukkhaṃ, dukkhan'ti, bhante, vuccati. kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, dukkhaṃ vā assa dukkhapaññatti vā'ti

32915.meaningLit: discourse on the question about suffering

32916.meaning1: averse to suffering; opposed to pain
32916.meaning2: averse to pain, finding suffering disagreeable

examples.text: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikūlo.

32917.meaning1: averse to suffering; opposed to pain
32917.commentary: (MNa) dukkhapaṭikkūlan'ti dukkhassa paṭikūlaṃ, paccanīkasaṇṭhitaṃ dukkhaṃ apatthayamānan'ti attho.

examples.text: yv'āyaṃ, bhante, puggalo attan'tapo attaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto so attānaṃ sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, iminā me ayaṃ puggalo cittaṃ n'ārādheti.

32918.meaning1: afflicted with suffering; overcome by misery
32918.commentary: (ITIa) dukkhaparetā'ti tehi dukkhadukkhavatthūhi abhibhūtā. jāti'ādayo hi dukkhassa vatthubhāvato dukkhā, dukkhabhāvato ca soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā dukkhā'ti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, otiṇṇo'mhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkh'otiṇṇo dukkhapareto.

32920.meaning2: having afflicted, having caused pain, having hurt

32922.meaning1: averse to suffering; opposed to pain

examples.text: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikūlo.

32923.meaning1: averse to suffering; opposed to pain
32923.commentary: (MNa) dukkhapaṭikkūlan'ti dukkhassa paṭikūlaṃ, paccanīkasaṇṭhitaṃ dukkhaṃ apatthayamānan'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā, pūrā aṅgārānaṃ vīt'accikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikkūlo.

32924.meaning1: being in suffering; afflicted with pain
32924.meaning2: being in suffering; afflicted with pain; lit. reached pain

examples.text: idāni maṃ edisaṃ evaṃ dukkhappattaṃ disvā tava alaṃ hasituṃ, mā edise kāle parihāsakeḷiṃ karohī'ti.
āraddhaṃ kho pana me, aggivessana, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho ten'eva dukkhappadhānena padhān'ābhitunnassa sato.

32927.meaning1: full of problems; with many troubles
32927.commentary: (MNa) dukkhabahulā'ti pettivisayasmiñ'hi dukkham'eva bahulaṃ, sukhaṃ parittaṃ kadāci anubhavitabbaṃ hoti, tasmā evam'āha.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ passāmi aparena samayena dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pettivisayaṃ upapannaṃ, dukkhabahulā vedanā vedayamānaṃ.

32929.meaning1: hard to endure; difficult to tolerate
32929.commentary: (THa) dukkhamamhi'pī'ti aññam'aññaṃ tikhiṇa-kasā-patod'ābhighāt'ādi-dukkhehi dussahāya'pi. liṅgavipallāsena h'etaṃ vuttaṃ, dukkhamamhi'pī'ti.

examples.text: saṃsaraṃ hi nirayaṃ agacchissaṃ, petalokam'agamaṃ punappunaṃ, dukkhamamhi'pi tiracchānayoniyaṃ, n'ekadhā hi vusitaṃ ciraṃ mayā.

32930.commentary: (SNa) yasmā ca sakadāgāmī vīriyena tatiyamaggaṃ ārādhetvā sakadāgāmimaggena anatītaṃ kāmoghavatthuṃ kāmoghasaññitañca kāmadukkhamacceti, tasmā vīriyena dukkhamaccetī'ti iminā padena kām'oghataraṇaṃ anāgāmimaggaṃ anāgāmiñ'ca pakāseti.

examples.text: kathaṃsu tarati oghaṃ, kathaṃsu tarati aṇṇavaṃ, kathaṃsu dukkham'acceti, kathaṃsu parisujjhatī'ti.
saddhā tarati oghaṃ, appamādena aṇṇavaṃ, vīriyena dukkham'acceti, paññāya parisujjhati.
kathaṃvidhaṃ sīlavantaṃ vadanti, kathaṃvidhaṃ paññavantaṃ vadanti, kathaṃvidho dukkham'aticca iriyati, kathaṃvidhaṃ devatā pūjayantī'ti.

32932.commentary: (ITIa) dukkhamaddakkhi sallato'ti yathā sallaṃ sarīraṃ anupavisantam'pi paviṭṭham'pi uddhariyamānam'pi pīḷam'eva janeti, evaṃ dukkhavedanā uppajjamānā'pi ṭhitippattā'pi bhijjamānā'pi vibādhati'y'evā'ti taṃ sallato vipassī'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yo dukkham'addakkhi yatonidānaṃ, kāmesu so jantu kathaṃ nameyya, upadhiṃ viditvā saṅgo'ti loke, tass'eva jantu vinayāya sikkhe'ti.
yo sukhaṃ dukkhato adda, dukkham'addakkhi sallato, adukkham'asukhaṃ santaṃ, adakkhi naṃ aniccato.
aniccaṃ aniccato dakkhuṃ, dukkham'addakkhu dukkhato, anattani anattā'ti, asubhaṃ asubhat'addasuṃ, sammādiṭṭhisamādānā, sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti
sace bhāyatha dukkhassa, sace vo dukkham'appiyaṃ, m'ākattha pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, āvi vā yadi vā raho.
na paro paraṃ nikubbetha, n'ātimaññetha katthaci naṃ kañci, byārosanā paṭighasaññā, n'āññam'aññassa dukkham'iccheyya.
kāmā hi citrā madhurā manoramā, aviddasū yattha sitā puthujjanā, te dukkham'icchanti punabbhav'esino, cittena nītā niraye nirākatā.
jhāya bhikkhu mā pamādo, mā te kāmaguṇe ramessu cittaṃ, mā lohaguḷaṃ gilī pamatto, mā kandi dukkham'idan'ti ḍayhamāno.
yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.

32938.meaning1: root of suffering; source of pain
32938.commentary: (MNa) passi jahi upadhidukkhamūlan'ti ettha passi nāma so paccekabuddho, dukkhassa pana mūlaṃ upadhiṃ jahī'ti ayam'assa thuti.

examples.text: buddho ahu maṅgalo vītarāgo, usabhacchidā jāliniṃ dukkhamūlaṃ, santaṃ padaṃ ajjhagam'opanīto, uposatho sundaro saccanāmo.

32939.commentary: (UDa) kuto taṃ dukkham'essatī'ti taṃ uttamapuggalaṃ kuto sattato saṅkhārato vā dukkhaṃ upagamissati, na tādisassa dukkhaṃ atthī'ti attho.

examples.text: yato yato mano nivāraye, na dukkham'eti naṃ tato tato, sa sabbato mano nivāraye, sa sabbato dukkhā pamuccati.
yassa sel'ūpamaṃ cittaṃ, ṭhitaṃ n'ānupakampati, virattaṃ rajanīyesu, kopaneyye na kuppati, yass'evaṃ bhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, kuto taṃ dukkham'essatī'ti.
bālo puttataṇhāya c'eva dhanataṇhāya ca haññati vihaññati dukkhayati

32942.meaning2: reason for the characteristic of suffering

32943.commentary: (DNt) tattha attā, loko'ti ca diṭṭhiyā adhiṭṭhānabhāvena, vedanā-phass'āyatan'ādi-mukhena ca gahitesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu taṇhāvajjā pañc'upādānakkhandhā dukkhasaccaṃ.

examples.text: dubbhikkham'iva vā dukkhasaccaṃ, dubbuṭṭhi viya samudayasaccaṃ, subhikkham'iva nirodhasaccaṃ, suvuṭṭhi viya maggasaccaṃ.

32944.meaning1: detailed analysis of the truth of suffering; investigation of the first truth

examples.text: tattha katamā jātī'ti-ādīsu padabhājanīyesu tatthā'ti dukkhasaccaniddese vuttesu jāti'ādīsu. yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānan'ti saṅkhepato anekesaṃ sattānaṃ sādhāraṇaniddeso.

32945.meaning2: what is called the truth of suffering

32946.meaning1: recognition of suffering; perception of no ease; perceiving discomfort (in)

examples.text: cha, bhikkhave, ānisaṃse sampassamānena alam'eva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā dukkhasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ. katame cha?
asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā, nirodhasaññā

32947.meaning1: fortified by the perception of suffering (in)

examples.text: anicce dukkhasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato ālasye kosajje vissaṭṭhiye pamāde ananuyoge apaccavekkhaṇāya tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ukkhittāsike vadhake.

32948.meaning1: recognizing suffering; perceiving no ease; perceiving discomfort (in)

examples.text: idha tvaṃ, dīghāvu, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassī viharāhi, anicce dukkhasaññī, dukkhe anattasaññī pahānasaññī virāgasaññī nirodhasaññī'ti. evañ'hi te, dīghāvu, sikkhitabban'ti.

32949.meaning1: source of stress; arising of suffering; appearance of discomfort

examples.text: yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chando ālayo anunayo ajjhosānaṃ so dukkhasamudayo. yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, so dukkhanirodho'ti. ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, avijjā? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ.

32950.meaning1: leading to the arising of suffering; which leads to the source of stress; which creates discomfort
32950.commentary: (SNa) dukkhasamudayagāminī samanupassanā'ti yasmā sakkāyo dukkhaṃ, tassa ca samudayagāminī paṭipadā nāma rūpaṃ attato samanupassatī'ti evaṃ diṭṭhisamanupassanā vuttā, tasmā dukkhasamudayagāminī samanupassanā'ti ayam'ettha attho hoti.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadā, sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadā'ti. iti h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati dukkhasamudayagāminī samanupassanā'ti. ayam'ev'ettha attho.

32951.meaning1: generation of the arising of suffering; creation of the source of stress; (comm) production of the mass of suffering
32951.meaning2: generation of the arising of suffering; creation of the source of stress

examples.text: viññāṇañ'ca hi, ānanda, nāmarūpe patiṭṭhaṃ na labhissatha, api nu kho āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ dukkhasamudayasambhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

32952.meaningLit: discourse on the origin of suffering

32953.meaning1: noble truth of the origin of suffering
32953.meaning2: noble truth of the origin of dukkha

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ? y'āyaṃ taṇhā ponobbhavikā nandīrāgasahagatā tatratatr'ābhinandinī. seyyath'idaṃ, kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā.
taṃ kho pan'idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pahātabban'ti

32954.meaning1: arising of discomfort; origination of suffering

examples.text: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ, dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ, ariyaṃ c'aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.

32955.meaning1: unpleasant to the touch; painful to the touch

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māgaṇḍiya, api nu so puriso iti c'itic'eva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyā'ti? evaṃ, bho gotama. taṃ kissa hetu? asu hi, bho gotama, aggi dukkhasamphasso c'eva mah'ābhitāpo ca mahāpariḷāho cā'ti.

32956.meaning1: unpleasantness to the touch; fact of being painful to the touch
32956.commentary: (MNt) āyatiṃ dukkhaphalatāya eta'r'ahi ca kilesadukkhabahulatāya kāmānaṃ dukkhasamphassatā, tadubhayasaṃyuttesu tesu ca taṃ asallakkhitvā ek'antasukh'ābhiniveso viparītasaññāya, na kevalāya sukhavedanāya sukhā'ti pavattasaññī.

examples.text: ye kho pan'assa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjanti, tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya. idam'assa dukkhasamphassatāya vadāmi. seyyathā'pi so, bhikkhave, potthako dukkhasamphasso tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
yo'pi hetu yo'pi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya, so'pi dukkho. dukkhasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ kuto sukhaṃ bhavissati!

32958.meaning1: considered to be stressful; regarded as painful; agreed to be uncomfortable

examples.text: sadevakassa lokassa, ete vo sukhasammatā, yattha c'ete nirujjhanti, taṃ nesaṃ dukkhasammataṃ.

bhikkhāya caranto kālānam'accayena jarājiṇṇo dubbhojanadukkhaseyyāhi milātasarīro bhikkhāya caranto āgamma pīṭhikāya nipanno niddaṃ okkamitvā uṭṭhāya nisinno attānaṃ oloketvā puttesu attano patiṭṭhaṃ apassanto cintesi
etañ'hi tumhe paṭipannā, dukkhass'antaṃ karissatha, akkhāto vo mayā maggo, aññāya sallakantanaṃ.
yo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye, appamatto vihassati, pahāya jātisaṃsāraṃ, dukkhass'antaṃ karissatī'ti.

32971.meaning1: who makes an end of suffering
32971.commentary: (ANa) dukkhass'antakaro hotī'ti sakalavaṭṭadukkhassa pariyantaṃ parivaṭumaṃ karo hoti.

examples.text: upasanto anāyāso, vippasanno anāvilo, kalyāṇasīlo medhāvī, dukkhass'antakaro siyā.
ettāvatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hotī'ti.
das'uttaraṃ pavakkhāmi, dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā, dukkhass'antakiriyāya, sabbaganthappamocanaṃ.

32973.meaning2: Chapter 6 of the Nidānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 2 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

32975.meaning1: removal of suffering; elimination of unease

examples.text: chandajaṃ aghaṃ chandajaṃ dukkhaṃ, chandavinayā aghavinayo, aghavinayā dukkhavinayo'ti.

32976.meaning1: resulting in suffering; with painful results
32976.meaning2: having pain as its fruit, creating misery

examples.text: samit'āssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā

yaṃ kho ahaṃ idaṃ kāyena kammaṃ kattu'kāmo idaṃ me kāyakammaṃ attabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, parabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, ubhayabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, akusalaṃ idaṃ kāyakammaṃ dukkh'udrayaṃ dukkhavipākan'ti

32977.meaning1: resulting in more suffering; with more painful results

examples.text: tatr'ānanda, yo c'ev'āyaṃ ācariy'ūpaddavo, yo ca antevās'ūpaddavo ayaṃ tehi brahmac'ārūpaddavo dukkhavipākataro c'eva kaṭukavipākataro ca, api ca vinipātāya saṃvattati.

32980.meaning1: painful feeling; unpleasant sensation; bad experience

examples.text: tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ pare akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti, so evaṃ pajānāti, uppannā kho me ayaṃ sotasamphassajā dukkhavedanā. sā ca kho paṭicca, no apaṭicca. kiṃ paṭicca?
dukkhavedaniyaṃ, bhikkhu, phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dukkhā vedanā. so dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti.
tass'eva dukkhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ dukkhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppannā dukkhā vedanā sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammatī'ti pajānāti.
taṃ kiṃ maññath'āvuso nigaṇṭhā, yam'idaṃ kammaṃ sukhavedanīyaṃ taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā dukkhavedanīyaṃ hotū'ti labbham'etan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

32984.commentary: (VISMa) sayam'pi dukkhahetu tvamitī'ti evaṃ sayam'pi tvaṃ etassa dukkhassa hetu, evaṃ samāne tassa tuyhañ'ca tassa dukkhassa hetubhāve

32985.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of dukkha
32985.commentary: (SNa) dukkhaṃ setī'ti jitāni hatthiādīni anusocanto dukkhaṃ sayissati. idaṃ bhagavā puna tassa jayakāraṇaṃ disvā āha.

examples.text: jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, dukkhaṃ seti parājito, upasanto sukhaṃ seti, hitvā jayaparājayaṃ.

kodhano'yaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodh'ābhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñ'c'āpi so pallaṅke seti gonak'atthate paṭalik'atthate kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇe sauttaracchade ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāne, atha kho so dukkhaññ'eva seti kodh'ābhibhūto.

katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ? jāti'pi dukkhā, jarā'pi dukkhā, maraṇam'pi dukkhaṃ, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā'pi dukkhā, appiyehi sampayogo'pi dukkho, piyehi vippayogo'pi dukkho, yam'p'icchaṃ na labhati tam'pi dukkhaṃ, saṃkhittena pañc'upādānakkhandhā dukkhā.

32987.meaning1: bringing suffering; causing discomfort; conducive to pain
32987.commentary: (ANa) jāti'pi dukkhā'ti-ādinā nayena vuttaṃ dukkhaṃ adhivahati āharatī'ti dukkh'ādhivahaṃ. dukkh'ādhivāhan'ti'pi pāṭho. tass'attho, lok'uttarapādakajjhān'ādi ariyadhamm'ābhimukhaṃ dukkhena adhivāhīyati pesīyatī'ti dukkh'ādhivāhaṃ. idam'pi vaṭṭavasena uppannacittam'eva.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ abhāvitaṃ abahulīkataṃ dukkh'ādhivahaṃ hoti yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ. cittaṃ, bhikkhave, abhāvitaṃ abahulīkataṃ dukkh'ādhivahaṃ hotī'ti.

32988.meaning1: bringing suffering; causing discomfort; conducive to pain

examples.text: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanā adantā aguttā arakkhitā asaṃvutā dukkh'ādhivāhā honti. katame cha? cakkhu, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanaṃ adantaṃ aguttaṃ arakkhitaṃ asaṃvutaṃ dukkh'ādhivāhaṃ hoti

32989.meaning1: afflicted with suffering; stricken by pain; fallen into misery

examples.text: duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.
rūpañ'ca h'idaṃ, mahāli, ek'antadukkhaṃ abhavissa dukkh'ānupatitaṃ dukkh'āvakkantaṃ anavakkantaṃ sukhena, na'y'idaṃ sattā rūpasmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ.
dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipannassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ayam'anudhammo hoti yaṃ rūpe dukkh'ānupassī vihareyya … parimuccati dukkhasmā'ti vadāmī'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabbasaṅkhāresu dukkh'ānupassī viharati.

32997.synonym: ārambhati, upahanti, khanati, tāpayati, paritāpeti, bādheti, byāpajjati, byābādheti, vihiṃsati, hanati, hiṃsati

examples.text: kissa rodathā'ti ca mātāpitūhi vuttā ime nimmātāpitikā tāpasapositā amhe atīva paharantī'ti vadanti. tato tesaṃ mātāpitaro ime dārakā aññe dārake viheṭhenti dukkhāpenti, na ime saṅgahetabbā, vajjitabbā ime'ti āhaṃsu.
ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujan'āhitāya bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū duggahitehi sutt'antehi byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca paṭibāhanti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujan'āhitāya paṭipannā bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
